tools.name: search_properties
tools.description: Find tokenized real-estate listings across RealT, Lofty, Binaryx and Reental. Filter by platform, country, text, payout status or recent trading. Each row has the last traded price, issue price, yield with its basis, payout status and caveats.

tools.name: get_property
tools.description: Full profile of one listing by its BrickTable id (from search_properties): price and issue price, yield with basis, payout status, tokens, holders and concentration, rent, ZIP-level home value and rent (US), recent trading, and caveats.

tools.name: get_property_trades
tools.description: Recorded secondary-market fills for one listing over the last 90 days, newest first, with quantity, price, settlement currency, USD value and a block-explorer link. Includes a summary (fill count, USD volume, volume-weighted price). The full history back to 2022 is available as a data license at bri

tools.name: get_recent_trades
tools.description: The most recent executed fills across all four platforms (or one), newest first.

tools.name: get_platform_overview
tools.description: Per-platform summary: listing counts, how many are paying distributions, traded volume over 30 and 90 days, and the median last traded price as a share of issue price.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_properties, get_property, get_platform_overview · Private data: get_property · Public sink: get_platform_overview.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_properties, get_property, get_platform_overview · Private data: get_property · Public sink: get_platform_overview

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
